definitions.explanation: An area of land designated for burying the dead, typically containing gravestones and memorials.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{墓|はか}は{町|まち}の{墓地|ぼち}にある。
examples.english: My grandfather's grave is in the town cemetery.

examples.japanese: お{盆|ぼん}には{家族|かぞく}で{墓地|ぼち}に{行|い}って{墓参|はかまい}りをするのが{毎年|まいとし}の{習慣|しゅうかん}だ。
examples.english: Every year during Obon, our family makes it a custom to visit the cemetery and pay respects at the grave.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墓地|ぼち}を{訪|おとず}れる: to visit a cemetery
- {市営|しえい}{墓地|ぼち}: municipal cemetery
- {共同|きょうどう}{墓地|ぼち}: communal cemetery
- {墓地|ぼち}の{管理|かんり}: cemetery maintenance

CULTURE: In Japan, most cemeteries are associated with Buddhist temples ({寺院|じいん}{墓地|ぼち}). Municipal and private cemeteries also exist. Visiting family graves ({墓参|はかまい}り) is an important custom, especially during Obon and the spring/autumn equinoxes ({彼岸|ひがん}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {墓地|ぼち}: general term for cemetery or burial ground
- {霊園|れいえん}: memorial park, garden cemetery (more modern, park-like)
- {墓場|はかば}: graveyard (slightly more informal or literary)
